about: Laws that have no researched outcome-web link in data/research/outcome-web/links.json, neither from the law itself nor from a measure an engine sets from it, and the outcome the research would measure. Each carries the stopgap that registers the gap; read by scripts/law-wiring/catalog.ts for the law-wiring matrix. The research belongs to the outcome-web line (pool item laws-outcome-links-unresearched).

laws.outcome: vehicle miles traveled and fuel use
household income after tax and out-migration
household prices and local retail sales

land conservation and park visits (Oct 24 search: no study sizes what a local or state natural resources line does to a measure the web keeps; Liu and Lynch 2011 sizes farmland preservation programs, not the line, and the web keeps no conserved-acres or park-visits measure)

youth social media use and mental health (the research contract data/research/outcome-web/social-media-age-verification-contracts.json sizes none of its four outcomes, and the web keeps no platform cost, teen access or identity exposure measure; an Oct 24 search found no before-and-after study of a state age-check law on a kept measure)
